quests.title: Goblins at the door
quests.ask: Goblins took a crate of rope off the Guild's road last night. The Guild pays its debts, {name}, and it collects them too. Ten of them should learn the price.
quests.thanks: Ten? That'll teach the rest. Pell the charcoal burner lives out in those woods. Go and see him. And the teachers here have work, if you want it.

quests.title: Ore for the forge

task.words: Gather 25 copper ore in Copper Hills

quests.ask: Garrow's forge eats copper faster than I dig it. Dig twenty-five ore in Copper Hills, {name}, and mind the loose rock.
quests.thanks: Twenty-five good lumps. Keep them. Garrow will show you what they're for.

quests.title: Wood for the fire

task.words: Gather 25 oak logs in Goblin Woods

quests.ask: Marta's fire is hungry, and so am I. Twenty-five oak logs from Goblin Woods. Watch for little green hands.
quests.thanks: Good wood. That'll keep the pot on till morning.

quests.title: Meat for the pot

task.words: Gather 12 venison on the deer trail

quests.ask: The camp eats too much bread. Twelve cuts of venison from the deer trail in Goblin Woods. Shoot clean.
quests.thanks: Clean cuts. Keep them for Marta. She'll know what to do.

quests.title: Perch at dawn
quests.ask: Perch bite all day at Mirror Lake, {name}. Fifteen of them, and keep your eyes on the water. Something big rolls out there.
quests.thanks: Fifteen perch, and you still have all your fingers. Good.

quests.title: Hides for the winter
quests.ask: Odda sent you? Then make yourself useful. My roof leaks, and my walls too. Fifteen goblin hides will patch them. The goblins won't need them.
quests.thanks: Hm. They stink, but they'll keep the rain out. Thank you, {name}.

quests.title: A blade of your own

task.words: Make a copper sword at the forge

quests.ask: Five copper ore makes a sword, {name}. Not a good one. Your own. Make it at my forge.
quests.thanks: Ugly. It'll cut. Now go and hit something with it.

quests.title: Something between you and the teeth
quests.ask: You go out there in your shirt? Four goblin hides make a vest. Make it, wear it, show me.
quests.thanks: Better. Now there's something between you and the teeth.

quests.title: Something hot

task.words: Cook 5 venison skewers at the camp fire

quests.ask: You've got venison? Then you can cook, {name}. Five skewers at my fire. A hero who can cook never goes hungry on the road.
quests.thanks: Not bad at all! Eat one before a hard fight. You'll feel it.

quests.title: The big brothers

task.words: Kill 20 goblin brutes in Goblin Woods

quests.ask: The small ones I can chase off with a stick. Not the big brothers. Twenty of them have been at my charcoal. Stop them.
quests.thanks: They came from the north, the brutes, same as the rest. Running. Go and tell Odda. She'll want to know.

quests.title: The old one

task.words: Kill the Old Bear in Goblin Woods

quests.ask: There's an old bear in the deep woods. Older than me. He kept to himself for years. Now the goblins push him out, and he's angry. Don't go unless you're ready.
quests.thanks: You beat the old one? Then the woods have a new old one, {name}.

quests.title: The dead walk
quests.ask: Goblins running south, and the dead walking in the Old Graveyard. It's the same trouble, {name}. I'd bet the ledger on it. Go and look. Aldous the sexton still lives out there.
quests.thanks: Skeletons in the old King's colours. I was afraid of that. Help Aldous. He won't ask, so I'm asking for him.

quests.title: Keep them down

task.words: Kill 40 skeletons in the Old Graveyard

quests.ask: They climb out every night, {name}. Forty of them back in the ground, and I might sleep a week. Might.
quests.thanks: Forty. They'll be back. They always come back while he's awake.

quests.title: Cloth for the graves
quests.ask: The zombies wear the old shrouds. I want them back, {name}. Fifteen pieces of grave cloth, to bind the graves shut. Don't ask me how I know that works.
quests.thanks: There. Bound. Now only one grave is still open, and it's the one with the crown.

quests.title: Bones for a shield

task.words: Make a bone shield at the forge

quests.ask: Copper's soft. Bone from the graveyard is harder, if you can stomach it. Five bones and two oak logs make a shield.
quests.thanks: Good. Don't think about whose they were.

quests.title: The King Who Would Not Rest
quests.ask: Aldous says the King wakes his guard every night. Put him back in the ground, {name}, and the road north opens. The Guild has waited a hundred years for that road.
quests.thanks: The King is down. Whatever comes next comes from the north. Rest tonight. Tomorrow the road is yours.

quests.title: Fish for a secret
quests.ask: You want a secret? Secrets cost. Fifteen sea bass off my rocks, friend, and I'll owe you one. A small one.
quests.thanks: Fair trade. Here's your secret: the crates I ship go north, to the Peak. Who pays for them? That one costs more.

quests.title: The moor bites
quests.ask: Odda's letter says you're the one who put the King down. Good. The wolves come closer every night. Forty fewer, and my watch can sleep.
quests.thanks: Forty. The rest will think twice. And they're not hunting, {name}. They're running from something.

quests.title: The pale ones
quests.ask: The pale ones walk the moor at night. Old soldiers, some say, who never got home. Your armour won't help. Your blade will.
quests.thanks: Quieter now. Whatever they were waiting for, it isn't here. It's north.

quests.title: Robbers on the ridge
quests.ask: Bandits from the ridge rob every Guild cart on this road. Every cart but one kind. Fifty of them, {name}, and the road is ours again.
quests.thanks: Fifty, and their pockets full of old crowns. Odd coin for bandits. Go on to Troll Bridge. Tobin the carter knows the road past it.

quests.title: Webs on the arches

task.words: Kill 40 giant spiders at Troll Bridge

quests.ask: Maud sent you? Bless her. The spiders on the arches took my brother's mule last week. Forty of them, and I'll cross without looking up.
quests.thanks: Forty! I looked up anyway. Habit. Now the trolls, if you've the stomach for it.

quests.title: Under the bridge
quests.ask: The trolls under the bridge mend as fast as you cut them. They take what the Chieftain leaves. Thirty of them, friend. Cut fast.
quests.thanks: Thirty. My knees are still shaking, and I only watched. That leaves the big one.

quests.title: Paid in Old Gold
quests.ask: The Chieftain owns this bridge. Every cart pays, and some carts pay in old gold to go free. I never ask. Put him down, and nobody pays again.
quests.thanks: He's down! The bridge is free. The cage I hauled went up the pass, friend. Whatever it's for, it's up there now.

quests.title: Wind off the moor
quests.ask: The wind off this moor goes straight through Guild cloth. Six wolf pelts and a bit of grave cloth make a vest. Wear one.
quests.thanks: Better. Now you look like you live here.

quests.title: Pale fire
quests.ask: The pale ones leave a glow behind them. It burns in a lamp, cold and blue, and they keep away from it. Ten, for the watch-fires.
quests.thanks: Cold light. Ugly, but it works. The moor will be darker for them tonight.

quests.title: Coats for the Guild
quests.ask: Maud writes that the moor is freezing, and my people up there wear Guild cloth. Fifteen wolf pelts, {name}, and I'll have coats made.
quests.thanks: Fifteen. That's coats for the whole outpost. Maud will pretend she's not grateful.

quests.title: Dark stone

task.words: Gather 30 iron ore on Iron Ridge

quests.ask: Copper's for beginners. Past the moor there's a ridge of dark stone, heavy with iron. Thirty ore, {name}. Mind the bandits.
quests.thanks: Iron! Feel the weight of it. Keep it. Garrow will want a word.

quests.title: Ash for the hafts

task.words: Gather 30 ash logs on Grey Moor

quests.ask: Ash grows on the moor, straight and tough. Best wood for a haft. Thirty logs, and don't let the wolves sniff your boots.
quests.thanks: Good straight ash. That'll hold a spearhead through anything.

quests.title: Elk on the moor

task.words: Gather 15 elk meat on the moor tracks

quests.ask: Elk walk the moor in herds. Fifteen cuts, {name}, and walk soft. An elk hears you before you hear yourself.
quests.thanks: Clean cuts. Take them to Marta. She has plans for them.

quests.title: Trout under the bridge

task.words: Gather 20 brown trout under the bridge

quests.ask: Brown trout lie under Troll Bridge, fat as a fist. Twenty of them. The trolls won't mind. Probably.
quests.thanks: Twenty trout, and no troll bites. You're getting good at this.

quests.title: A roast for the road

task.words: Cook 5 elk roasts at the camp fire

quests.ask: Elk meat? Then we roast. Five elk roasts at my fire, {name}. Slow and hot. The road north is cold.
quests.thanks: Smell that! Eat one before the bridge. You'll thank me.

quests.title: Iron for your head

task.words: Make an iron helm at the forge

quests.ask: Five iron ore makes a helm. Make one at any forge. Maud's outpost has one. Your head's worth it.
quests.thanks: Solid. Ugly, but solid. Like all good helms.

quests.title: Rope for the cart
quests.ask: Spider silk makes a rope that never breaks. My cart ropes are rotten. Twelve silk, friend, and I'll haul anything.
quests.thanks: Strong as iron. I'll haul your gear for free next time.

quests.title: A coat that closes
quests.ask: Troll hide closes over its own cuts. Six of it and four leather make armour. Make it, wear it, show me.
quests.thanks: Now that's a coat. Cut it and watch it close.

quests.title: Stones that walk

task.words: Kill 15 stone golems in Mountain Pass

quests.ask: The hero of the bridge, at my lodge! The golems have blocked the mule road for a month. Fifteen of them, and my supplies move again.
quests.thanks: The road is open! Dinner is on the lodge tonight, {name}. It always is, for you.

quests.title: Walls for the lodge
quests.ask: A golem's core is the hardest stone there is. Eight of them, and I'll shore up the lodge walls before winter.
quests.thanks: Splendid. Heavy, aren't they? They'll hold anything.

quests.title: Claws from the sun
quests.ask: The harpies dive on my mules from the sun. Thirty of them, {name}. My men on the Peak wait for their supplies. Look in on them, if you go up.
quests.thanks: The mules move again. If you go up to the Peak, tell my men that Corvin sends his best.

quests.title: The lodge men
quests.ask: Corvin's men? They're gone. They built a cage for the dragon and woke it with their hammers. It ate the cage. Now the wyverns circle, because it's awake. Thin them, and we'll talk.
quests.thanks: Thirty-five. They'll come back while it's awake. Corvin never wanted it dead, you know. He wanted it for himself.

quests.title: Fire on the slopes

task.words: Kill 30 fire drakes on Dragon's Peak

quests.ask: The drakes guard the way to its bed. Plated like knights and burning. My grandfather said to bring a hammer. Thirty of them, {name}.
quests.thanks: That's the last of the guard. Only the dragon now. Rest first.

quests.title: The Cage on the Peak
quests.ask: Young for a dragon. Old for everything else. My grandfather came to finish it a hundred years ago. Finish it for him, {name}.
quests.thanks: It's dead. A hundred years of watching, done. Thank you, {name}. Now come and see what lies behind its bed.

quests.title: The dead of the pass
quests.ask: The dead of the pass, in their old shrouds. They guard something, the miners say. Thirty of them, and the pass is safe for everyone.
quests.thanks: Thirty! They guard nothing now. Nothing at all.

quests.title: Soft beds
quests.ask: Harpy feathers make the softest beds in the north. Twelve, {name}, and every guest of the lodge sleeps like a king.
quests.thanks: Wonderful. A king's bed for a king's... well. For a guest.

quests.title: Against the fire
quests.ask: Its breath melts iron. Three drake fangs and six feathers make a ward against fire. Wear one, or don't go near its bed.
quests.thanks: Good. Now the fire might not take you at once.

quests.title: Proof for the council
quests.ask: Nessa's letter came. A Guild man, building a cage on the Peak. The council won't take my word against Corvin's. Bring me ten wyvern scales, burned black by the dragon's own fire.
quests.thanks: Proof. The council will read my letter now. Thank you, {name}. I wish it had been anyone but Corvin.

quests.title: The second secret
quests.ask: Back from the north, friend? Still want to know who pays for my crates? Six troll hides. My new boat needs a hull that doesn't tear.
quests.thanks: Here's your secret: the crates are signed for at the Guild lodge on the pass. Old gold, and a Guild seal in the wax. Whose hand? I only sell what I know.

quests.title: Silver in the dark

task.words: Gather 25 mithril ore in Mithril Deep

quests.ask: Silver light in the dark, they say, and a long way down. Twenty-five mithril ore, {name}. Under the hills we'd give a beard for that.
quests.thanks: Mithril! Light as a feather, hard as a grudge. Keep it.

quests.title: Pine from the pass

task.words: Gather 25 pine logs in Mountain Pass

quests.ask: Pine from the high pass burns hot and long. Twenty-five logs, {name}. Watch for falling stones.
quests.thanks: Smell that resin. The camp fire will burn all week.

quests.title: The cold tarn

task.words: Gather 15 arctic char at the cold tarn

quests.ask: The cold tarn up the pass is clear as glass, and full of char. Fifteen, {name}. Keep your fingers out of the water.
quests.thanks: Fifteen, and all your fingers. The tarn was kind to you.

quests.title: Up on the crags

task.words: Gather 15 ibex meat on the high crags

quests.ask: Ibex climb where nothing else climbs. Fifteen cuts from the high crags, {name}. Don't look down.
quests.thanks: You looked down, didn't you? Everyone does. Good meat.

quests.title: Soup for cold days

task.words: Cook 5 char soups at the camp fire

quests.ask: Arctic char makes a soup that keeps you warm through a night on the ice. Five bowls, {name}, at my fire.
quests.thanks: Warm to the toes! Take some up the pass. You'll need it.

quests.title: A blade of silver

task.words: Make a mithril sword at the forge

quests.ask: Eight mithril ore makes a sword that never dulls. Make one, {name}. Corvin's lodge has a good forge, I'm told.
quests.thanks: Look at that edge. I couldn't have made it better. Don't tell anyone I said so.

endWords: The dragon is dead, and the lands are quiet. For now.
